name: flight
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: barn owl animation pose reference sheet for a stylized WebGL game, not a finished sprite atlas.
Input image 1 is the original photographic appearance reference. Image 2 is the established full-body turnaround for proportions and identity. Preserve the same barn owl: white heart-shaped facial disk, black eyes, ivory beak, golden buff/silver-gray speckled back, pale breast, no ear tufts.
Create a clean high-resolution 4-column by 3-row sheet with exactly 12 separate complete owls. Columns are four consecutive key poses described below. Rows show those SAME four poses from three fixed cameras: top row front, middle row left side profile facing image left, bottom row rear three-quarter. Camera remains fixed within each row. Keep anatomy, body scale, and feather palette consistent. Each cell must have generous transparent margins, including fully extended wings and feet. No overlaps or cropping. No text, labels, borders, arrows, ground, perches, shadows, scenery, or motion trails. Genuine transparent background, neutral diffuse lighting. Realistic natural anatomy simplified enough for clear silhouette study. Do not embed shader effects; these images guide approximate geometry and motion.

State specification: Flight wingbeat cycle. All poses airborne, body pitched forward for flight, feet tucked. Columns: 1 wings raised at top of upstroke; 2 wings extended roughly horizontal midway through powerful downstroke; 3 wings lowered at bottom of downstroke; 4 wings partly folded and lifting in recovery upstroke. Wings are broad owl wings, attached anatomically at shoulders, two wings total. Show meaningful pose differences; no grounded standing birds.
